heading: Establishment of demonstration project; selection of participating Indian tribes

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary shall establish and carry out an Indian trust asset management demonstration project, in accordance with this subchapter.

children.heading: In general
children.text: An Indian tribe shall be eligible to participate in the project if—
the Indian tribe submits to the Secretary an application under subsection (c); and
the Secretary approves the application of the Indian tribe.

children.heading: In general
children.text: The Secretary shall provide a written notice to each Indian tribe approved to participate in the project.

children.heading: Contents
children.text: A notice under subparagraph (A) shall include—
a statement that the application of the Indian tribe has been approved by the Secretary; and
a requirement that the Indian tribe shall submit to the Secretary a proposed Indian trust asset management plan in accordance with section 5613 of this title.

children.heading: In general
children.text: To be eligible to participate in the project, an Indian tribe shall submit to the Secretary a written application in accordance with paragraph (2).

children.heading: Requirements
children.text: The Secretary shall consider an application under this subsection only if the application—
includes a copy of a resolution or other appropriate action by the governing body of the Indian tribe, as determined by the Secretary, in support of or authorizing the application;
is received by the Secretary after June 22, 2016; and
states that the Indian tribe is requesting to participate in the project.
shall remain in effect for a period of 10 years after June 22, 2016; but
may be extended at the discretion of the Secretary.
